mapper.sql: emi.management_item_id as "managementItemId", ee.element_id as "elementId", ei.item_id as "itemId", ea.area_id as "areaId", ea.rule_version_id as "ruleVersionId", erv.version_code as "versionCode", erv.version_status as "versionStatus", ea.area_code as "areaCode", ea.area_name as "areaName", ei.item_code as "itemCode", ei.item_name as "itemName", ee.evaluation_year as "evaluationYear", ee.element_code as "elementCode", ee.element_name as "elementName", emi.management_item_code as "managementItemCode", emi.management_item_name as "managementItemName", emi.sort_order as "sortOrder", emi.active_yn as "activeYn", emi.teacher_editable_yn as "teacherEditableYn", emi.required_yn as "requiredYn", emi.data_type as "dataType", emi.change_reason as "changeReason", emi.updated_by as "updatedBy", emi.updated_at as "updatedAt"

from evaluation_management_items emi inner join evaluation_elements ee on ee.element_id = emi.element_id inner join evaluation_items ei on ei.item_id = ee.item_id inner join evaluation_areas ea on ea.area_id = ei.area_id inner join evaluation_rule_versions erv on erv.rule_version_id = ea.rule_version_id

where.if: and (emi.management_item_code ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%') or emi.management_item_name ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%') or emi.data_type ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%') or ee.element_code ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%') or ee.element_name ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%') or ei.item_code ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%') or ei.item_name ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%') or ea.area_code ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%') or ea.area_name ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%'))

mapper.insert: insert into evaluation_management_items (element_id, management_item_code, management_item_name, sort_order, active_yn, teacher_editable_yn, required_yn, data_type, change_reason, created_by, updated_by) values (#{elementId}, #{request.managementItemCode}, #{request.managementItemName}, #{request.sortOrder}, #{request.activeYn}, #{request.teacherEditableYn}, #{request.requiredYn}, #{request.dataType}, #{request.changeReason}, #{updatedBy}, #{updatedBy}) on conflict (element_id, management_item_code) do update set management_item_name = EXCLUDED.management_item_name, sort_order = EXCLUDED.sort_order, active_yn = EXCLUDED.active_yn, teacher_editable_yn = EXCLUDED.teacher_editable_yn, required_yn = EXCLUDED.required_yn, data_type = EXCLUDED.data_type, change_reason = EXCLUDED.change_reason, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by

insert into data_change_histories (target_business, target_key, change_type, field_name, before_value, after_value, changed_by, change_reason, request_id) values (#{targetBusiness}, #{targetKey}, #{changeType}, #{fieldName}, #{beforeValue}, #{afterValue}, #{changedBy}, #{changeReason}, #{requestId})
